metadata.title: Non-Equilibrium Syntropic Thermodynamics: Reversal of Entropic Dissipation via Topological Attractors in Solitonic Media
metadata.description:
We establish the generalized Second Law of Thermodynamics extended to manifolds exhibiting retrocausal boundary conditions. By incorporating negative-divergence syntropic currents J_syn = κ (E × B) · ∂Φ_adv/∂t, the net entropy variation rate dS_total/dt = dS_irr/dt - ∇·J_syn ≤ 0. We prove that energy degradation in closed-cycle systems can be halted and cyclically reversed without violating unitarity. This unlocks zero-emission thermodynamic cycles operating beyond standard Carnot limits for micro-turbines, grid stabilization, and indefinite life-cycle solid-state batteries.

Humanitarian Applications:

  • Transición Energética Global: Aumenta la eficiencia de plantas de ciclo combinado y elimina el calentamiento térmico residual en centros de datos urbanos.
  • Sistemas de Baterías de Larga Vida: Previene la degradación dendrítica en baterías de litio y estado sólido, multiplicando su vida útil por 10x y reduciendo residuos electrónicos.
